label: Diagram 3.1
caption: Diagram 3.1 | Gallery floors with no alternative exit
description: An isometric diagram of a room containing a raised gallery floor, with a staircase rising along the right side up to the gallery. A title bar at the bottom reads "Diagram 3.1" and "Gallery floors with no alternative exit"; the top left corner reads "See para 3.13". A diagonal dimension line across the upper room is marked "7.5 max."; a dimension line along the lower right edge is marked "3m max.". A green arrow labelled "Exit" points outward through a door in the lower right wall. A green-shaded area on the lower floor is indicated by a leader line carrying the label "Visible area to be at least 50% of floor area in lower room". To the right, a NOTES panel contains two numbered notes, each with sub-clauses i and ii, referencing an alternative escape route, an emergency escape window (where the gallery floor is not more than 4.5m above ground level), and cooking facilities within a room containing a gallery.
